RULE #1: edit here + refreshMchataisourceCache to ship a new model with zero rebuild. role -> CloudProvider rawValue -> direct-API SKU. Mirrored by RoleModelService.swift's frozen fallback.

visualEvaluatorVision._comment: VisualEvaluatorService — cheap vision model, runs on every install render-gate probe.

videoAnalysisVision._comment: VideoAnalysisService — capable vision model for frame/scene analysis.

coding._comment: Strong code-generation SKU per provider. Used to UPGRADE a weak (mini/flash/haiku) selection under Best Quality so an API fallback can never emit a truncated app. Edit here + refreshMchataisourceCache to change with zero rebuild.

sketchGeneration._comment: ToonSketchGenerator — draws a cutout puppet/backdrop as structured JSON. Wants a capable model; the output is geometry, and a weak model produces flat shapes.

uiAssertion._comment: UIAssertionService + DebugTestTunnel screenshot assertions — cheap vision, runs per QA probe.

quizGeneration._comment: QuiznectStore — question generation. Cheap is fine; volume matters more than depth.
